It's great that you've found something that boosts your confidence. Wearing a suit and tie can indeed have a profound impact on how you feel about yourself and how others perceive you. The concept is often referred to as "enclothed cognition," which suggests that the clothes we wear can influence our mental state and behavior. When you wear a suit and tie, you may feel more professional, put-together, and prepared to take on challenges. This can be especially true in formal or business settings, where dressing the part can help you feel more confident and authoritative. Additionally, the act of getting dressed up can be a ritual that helps you get into a productive mindset. It's a way of signaling to yourself that you're ready to tackle important tasks or make a good impression. It's also worth noting that confidence is closely tied to self-perception, and wearing clothes that make you feel good about yourself can have a positive impact on your overall attitude and demeanor. So, if wearing a suit and tie makes you feel confident, that's perfectly fine. Own it, and use it to your advantage. Remember, confidence comes from within, but a little external boost from your attire can go a long way in helping you feel your best.
